Invoke manager vtable slot +28 with a2, then vtable slot +4 with the v4 buffer pair, argument 1 and 0 to load/play the sound
If the returned buffer v4[0] is non-null, FreeWrapper_7bcf(v4[0]) frees it
Return the result buffer; invoked from the net-comm player slot sync, session state dispatch and a local helper
